title: RentGuard Renters Policy Rate Page — Contents Rate, Minimum Premium, Discounts and Co-Insured Charge
content:
The rate page of the RentGuard Renters Policy gives, tier by tier, the figures the annual premium is built from: the annual contents rate per 1,000 USD of Coverage C (before territory and deductible factors), the smallest annual premium the tier charges, the autopay discount on the monthly EFT plan, the multi-policy discount, and whether and at what annual charge a roommate may be added as an additional named insured.

| Tier | Contents rate per 1,000 USD of Coverage C | Minimum annual premium (USD) | Autopay discount on the monthly EFT plan (percent) | Multi-policy discount (percent) | Roommate may be added as co-insured | Annual co-insured charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 4.82 | 118.00 | 0 | 5 | no | 0.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 5.16 | 124.00 | 0 | 5 | no | 0.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 5.94 | 149.00 | 3 | 7 | yes | 18.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 6.47 | 176.00 | 3 | 7 | yes | 18.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 7.38 | 219.00 | 5 | 10 | yes | 15.00 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 8.65 | 298.00 | 5 | 10 | yes | 0.00 |

## Definitions used on this page

- **Autopay discount** — the discount on the monthly EFT plan; a tier showing 0 has none.
- **Multi-policy discount** — the discount available while the customer also holds a live Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or Larkspur Valuables Floater.
- **Co-insured charge** — the annual premium for an additional named insured. HO-4 Starter and HO-4 Essential do not allow a roommate as co-insured at all; on HO-4 Signature a roommate may be added and the charge is 0.00.
- **Minimum annual premium** — the smallest annual premium the tier charges.

## Hypothetical reading

For a RentGuard HO-4 Premier policy with a Coverage C limit of 30000, the contents rate of 6.47 per 1,000 USD applied to 30 thousands gives 194.10 before territory and deductible factors; the figure the tier will never go below is 176.00.
